title.ms: Bayang dan tangan: 200 tahun Wayang Kulit Siam
title.en: The shadow and the hand: 200 years of Wayang Kulit Siam

standfirst.ms: Dalang duduk di belakang kelir putih yang diregangkan dengan pelita minyak kelapa di bahunya, dan selama enam jam dia menjadi setiap watak serentak: suara, pemain patung, dan konduktor gamelan di belakangnya.
standfirst.en: The dalang sits behind a stretched white screen with a coconut-oil lamp at his shoulder, and for six hours he is every character at once: the voice, the puppeteer, the conductor of the gamelan behind him.

body.ms: Wayang Kulit Siam tiba di Kelantan melalui laluan perdagangan dengan selatan Thailand, dan repertoirnya berpaksikan Ramayana sebagaimana ia diceritakan semula di sini — Hikayat Seri Rama. Patung dipahat daripada kulit kerbau, ditebuk supaya cahaya menembusinya, dan diwarnakan walaupun penonton hanya melihat bayangnya.
body.en: Wayang Kulit Siam arrived in Kelantan through trade routes with southern Thailand, and its repertoire drew on the Ramayana as it was retold locally — the Hikayat Seri Rama. Puppets are cut from buffalo hide, perforated so the light passes through, and painted even though the audience sees only their outline.
